Asha R: Quick heads-up — found a gap where some onboarding events (first_call, doc_sent) aren't mapping to healthscore buckets when contact.email is null. This is causing ~2% of trials to show 'No Activity' in the dashboard. @Marco L can we patch the playbook telemetry mapping?
Marco L: Yup saw that in the spike last night. Looks like the ETL dropped rows where email is empty instead of using external_id.
Priya S: Ugh. That's the old ingestion rule from the legacy import. We changed it for churn calc but missed playbooks.
Asha R: Proposal: quick 2-step fix — 1) update mapping to fall back to contact.external_id if email is null, 2) run a rehydrate for last 30 days for accounts in onboarding state. Low risk, fast rollback. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Sam K: +1 for fallback. For rehydrate, can we limit to accounts where healthscore changed to "No Activity" during the window? Don't want to reprocess everything.
Marco L: Agree. I can prepare a migration that: 
```sql
-- find impacted accounts
SELECT account_id FROM onboarding_events
WHERE event_type IN ('first_call','doc_sent')
AND contact_email IS NULL
AND received_at >= now() - interval '30 days';
```
Then reemit events to the playbook queue with `source = 'rehydrate_crm_patch'`.
Priya S: Also let's add a unit to the healthscore test harness so future imports can't drop fallback. Add a sentinel case for null email -> use external_id mapping.
Asha R: Good call. Can somebody own the rollout checklist? I can do a quick doc but need an owner for the migration run and a monitoring plan.
Sam K: I can own migration run and smoke checks. Will set alerts for backlog > 1000 and for any playbook failure rate spike.
Marco L: I’ll open a PR for the mapping change (small) and include the SQL above. ETA EOD my side.
Priya S: I'll add a unit test to the playbook telemetry repo and schedule a quick CI gate.
CS Ops Bot: Note: scheduled deploy window tomorrow 09:00–10:00 UTC. Reply with :thumbsup: to opt-in.
Asha R: Opting in. Also adding rollback steps: 1) revert mapping change, 2) pause rehydrate queue. Documented in thread.
Sam K: Plan: run rehydrate in incremental batches of 500 accounts, verify healthscore delta sampling after each batch. If >5% unexpected churn revert.
Marco L: PR is up: https://git.internal/redwood/playbook-telemetry/pull/342 — includes fallback, migration flag, and changelog entry.
Priya S: CI gate green for the unit test.
Asha R: Thanks team. After migration and verification we'll publish a short note for CSMs explaining the transient healthscore flips and expected timeline. :white_check_mark:
Sam K: I'll post the CSM note draft in #customer-success later today for review.
Marco L: Deploying mapping change in tomorrow's window. Sam, ping me when you start rehydrate so I can watch logs.
Asha R: Closing loop: retrospective item — add an ingestion-level schema rule to treat email as optional for playbook mapping. Filed as ticket CSOPS-287.
Priya S: Nice. That should prevent surprises.
CS Ops Bot: Migration job created: job_id=rehydrate-1719004321-01 status=scheduled for 2024-06-02T09:15:00Z
Asha R: Great — team, thanks for the quick turnaround.
